rationale: All artifact uses across architecture, crosswalks, assurance case, planning notes, video script/visual materials, and whitepaper consistently maintain the claim's exact scope and limitations. limitations: UK military aviation guidance effective 10 October 2025; not civil-airworthiness approval or a product safety case
